text: Across 413 debates and consultancies, the paper reports human debate accuracy of 84% versus 74% for human consultancy (p = 0.04 by proportion test), with GPT-4 debate and consultancy between them at 78% and 80%. Judges beat chance in all settings, human debate falls 8.5 points short of an estimated 92.5% upper bound, and human-debate accuracy is 88% for judgments made with at least 95% confidence.
